## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Track D (design rules and UI component setup), wave D3. This is audit backlog UX-19 of the Nov 2026 product UX audit (an audit id, not an MDV key).

Persona and route: /front-desk · receptionist.
Findings and reviewers: F-12 · reviewers B-02, B-06, C-23 · arbitration ruling 4.
Rationale: The board shows about one and a half cards per column on a first screen; a grouped list shows about nine patients in the same space. The arbitration keeps the board for the pilot and adds the list later as a choice.
Proposed UX behaviour: A third view, List, in the view switch. Rows grouped by status in the order of who needs action: waiting, with nurse, in consult, then booked, then done (collapsed). Status counts above the list act as filters. Each row: token, patient name, flags, wait, the doctor, one action; rows are 48 px (comfortable), actions 44 px, never compact. Order within a group follows the clinic's queue rule and matches the display. Undo sits in the toolbar. Check-in from a search result keeps the identity confirmation (name and date of birth) and shows the doctor being assigned. By status and By doctor stay; each receptionist's last choice is the default for her.
Prototype and blueprint reference: docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/medvya-workspace-concept.html, receptionist view (audit notes 8, 9 and 10); screenshots docs/product-ux-audit/concepts/screenshots/desk-1440.png, desk-1024.png, desk-768.png, desk-375.png, desk-1440-annotated.png. The concept's 40 px rows and Booked first are not built: see the rulings.
Components and tokens affected: QueueTable, SegmentedControl, Chip, the table controller. No new component.
Front end and back end split: Front end only (the board object and live feed are view-agnostic).
Prerequisites and blocked by: Blocked by the undo ticket, the board chrome ticket, the queue-rule ticket and the picker-rows ticket. Timing: after the first pilot weeks, or before the first staff training session if the founder moves it there; never between training and the first two pilot weeks (arbitration ruling 6).
Clinical sign-off: Decision: question 14 of the validation plan (board or list), by the receptionist, with the side-by-side of receptionist scenario step 8; recorded on the issue.
Effort and regression risk: M · Low: an added view; the board is untouched.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: (1) Removing or replacing the board. (2) 40 px rows or any compact density on this list. (3) A single find-or-check-in box.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given Front desk, when the view switch is read, then By status, By doctor and List are offered and the first two behave as before
- [ ] **AC2.** Given 20 booked and 6 waiting patients, when the list opens, then the waiting group is first and done is collapsed
- [ ] **AC3.** Given the status counts, when one is pressed, then only that group shows and the pressed state is exposed to assistive technology
- [ ] **AC4.** Given 40 rows with long names at 1024 by 768 and 1440 by 900, when the list renders, then no text is clipped and no sideways scrolling occurs
- [ ] **AC5.** Given any pointer, when rows and actions are measured, then rows are at least 48 px and actions at least 44 px with at least 8 px between actions in adjacent rows
- [ ] **AC6.** Given a search result in the list, when Check in is pressed, then name and date of birth are confirmed first, as on the board
- [ ] **AC7.** Given the clinic's queue rule, when the list and the queue display are compared, then the order within a status is the same
- [ ] **AC8.** Given English and Arabic at 1440, 1024 and 375, when axe runs, then there is no violation
